achievements.hint: Complete the first area of the Underworld: Erebus.
Complete the second area of the Underworld: Oceanus.
Complete the third area of the Underworld: Fields of Mourning.
Complete the fourth area of the Underworld: Tartarus.
Complete the first area of the Surface: City of Ephyra.
Complete the second area of the Surface: Rift of Thessaly.
Complete the third area of the Surface: Mount Olympus.
Complete the fourth area of the Surface: Summit

achievements.description: Cast 50 Incantations at the Crossroads Cauldron
achievements.hint: Pretty hard to not get, just do every incantation you get.

achievements.description: Take one of your comrades to the Hot Springs
achievements.hint:
To unlock the Soothing Soak achievement you must complete the incantation "Rite of Vapor-Cleansing" to unlock the Hot Springs and then gift a character "Bathing Salts" to invite them. 
To get the incantation you need:
-Moros to arrive at the crossroad
-Gifted 6 or more nectar
-Gifted at least 2 to at least one of the following npcs: Hecate, Odysseus, Nemesis, Eris, Moros, Dora or Icarus

achievements.description: Take one of your comrades to the Fishing Pier
achievements.hint:
To unlock the Catch of the Night achievement you must complete the incantation "Rite of River-Fording" to unlock the Fishing Pier and then gift a character "Twin Lures" to invite them. 
To get the incantation you need:
-Rod of Fishing unlocked
-Gifted 12 or more nectar in total.

achievements.description: Take one of your comrades to the Taverna
achievements.hint:
To unlock the Ambrosia for Two achievement you must complete the incantation "Rite of Social-Solidarity" to unlock the Taverna and then gift a character "Ambrosia" to invite them. 
To get the incantation you need to have gifted 12 or more nectar in total.

Most of the characters max bond levels are locked behind the ending and other requirements later but the ones you can get before that are Hephaestus and Charon.
Do note that the ones that have achievements tied to them are Dora, Odysseus, Arachne, Echo, Narcissus, and Hypnos.
Regardless, do atleast gift 1 nectar to every character for their keepsake, which is another achievement.

There's a total of 89 prophecies in Hades 2. Every god has their "Get all my boons" prophecies aswell as get all duo/legendary ones but besides that you won't really need to get out of your way, just aim to do whatever prophecy you can. You can find these after Moros enters the crossroads.

achievements.description: Gain 30 Grasp at the Altar of Ashes
achievements.hint:
The total cost to get Grasp 30 is 2,596 Psyche, 2 Shadow Extracts and 2 Darkness.
You upgrade your grasp level at the Altar of Ashes in the Training Grounds.
Unlock all of the Arcana cards at the Altar of Ashes in the training grounds.

To be able to upgrade Arcana you need to finish the incantation "Consecration of Ashes". To obtain the incantation you need to:
- Defeat Hecate 5 or more times
- Have 20 or more Grasp
- Unlock 10 or more Arcana Cards
- Summoning of Mercantile Fortune unlocked (Wretched Broker incantation)
You will receive the incantation from Hecate after defeating her.

achievements.description: Fulfill the Prophecy 'The Arms of Night'
achievements.hint: Unlock all six Nocturnal Arms in the Training Grounds. To unlock the last two, simply craft the other weapons.

Obtain all aspects of all of the Nocturnal Arms, including secret. For a guide on how to get the secret ones, check the "checklist" section for the Bearing of Dark Gifts checklist, which is tied to this achievement.
Near Melinoë's tent there's "Frinos", the frog. Interact with them after each run and you should get the achievement and prophecy after 6 runs.

To be able to recruit Animal Familiars you must complete the incantation "Faith of Familiar Spirits".
To unlock the incantation you need to:
- Defeat Hecate 7 times or more
- Gathered 2 times with the Crescent Pick
- Gathered 8 times with the Tablet of Peace
- Gathered 1 time with the Silver Spade

For a guide on how to get all animal familiars, check the checklist section.

To be able to upgrade Familiars, you must finish the incantation "Bravery of Familiar Spirits" which requires:
- The ability to recruit Animal Familiars
- Having spent 4 treats total in recruiting Animal Familiars.

You get kudos by recycling materials.
To do this you need to do the incantation "Earthly Fortune". To unlock said incantation, you need to:
- Gift at least 1 nectar to Dora
- Have at least 40 progression upgrades or more (Incantations, Nocturnal Arms, Familiars, etc.)
- Trigger the specific Dora dialogue that makes her able to start decorating the base. 
* There is an achievement related to Dora's relationship so don't get frustrated if you don't get the trigger, you'll get there eventually!

In case you want to start gathering materials early, the most expensive items to sell (in order) are: Flux (177kudos), Snake-Reed (140kudos), Poppy (140kudos), Olive/Wheat (120kudos), Cattail/Mandrake (100kudos), Thalamus (99kudos). Everything else gives under 99 kudos.
Olives are probably the easiest to farm although Thalamus gives 2 per harvest and you will only need 2 to unlock everything they can be used for in the entire game. Besides one bat incantation from Rubbish, Rubbish and Gemstones's main use is getting kudos, but they don't give much. 
*OPTIONAL: You might want to wait until you unlock the incantation "Observance of Gaia's Secrets" since it adds a 35% chance of getting an extra seed when harvesting, which is mega useful for the rare Origin Seeds. It requires all soil upgrades and the ability to upgrade gathering tools. To get all soil upgrades you need to harvest at least:
- 6 Moly
- 4 Nightshade
- 1 Cattail
- 1 Wheat
- 4 Mandrake
- 4 Poppy
- 4 Garlic
- 1 Olive

The way I farmed this achievement was by equipping "Hecuba, the Hound" as a familiar to improve the chances of seed spots appearing then going surface route to get Olives from Mount Olympus. As I do this, I take every chaos gate I see for even more seeds, while checking wells of charon for the item that guarantees a gate. 
With Observance of Gaia's Secrets and Origin seeds in all plots, I was able to plant -> do a bond event/chaos trial -> harvest all -> plant again -> go into a run.
Since each harvest gives you two Thalamus, with every soil plot with Origin Seeds, you get 1188 kudos which means you can be done with it in around 11 or less runs. Fill whatever you couldn't fill with olive branches and you'll be swimming in kudos in no time.

!!!You will only get the achievement after you *spend* a total of 10,000 kudos, as that is what the prophecy asks for.

You obtain a Keepsake the first time you gift a Nectar to an NPC.
For a full list of Keepsakes, check the checklist section.
Do know that 3 Keepsakes can only be given by post-game characters.

To unlock Chaos Trials one must finish the incantation "Abyssal Insight" obtained by
- Converting 3 Chaos curses into blessings then speaking to Chaos
- Doing the incantation "Unraveling a Fateful Bond" (obtained after speaking to Moros after a run in the Surface, regardless of outcome)

Once the incantation "Abyssal Insight" is done, head to the stone where the Infernal Arms are at and clear 20 Chaos Trials.

After unlocking all weapons and their aspects (including hidden), and having the Chaos Trials unlocked, you unlock the randomized Chaos Trials. These randomize weapons and keepsakes and depending if it's a "Great" trial or not, also randomizes Vows from the Oath of the Unseen.

For you to get this achievement you must clear two randomized trials **in a row**. I recommend first doing the achievement "Chaos in Hell" followed by a 0 fear randomized trial to avoid doing more than two of these.

The achievement pops shortly after getting back to base.

After unlocking all weapons and their aspects (including hidden), and having the Chaos Trials unlocked, you unlock the randomized Chaos Trials. These randomize weapons and keepsakes and depending if it's a "Great" trial or not, also randomizes Vows from the Oath of the Unseen.

For you to get this achievement you must specifically select the trial called "Great Chaos Below", which will take you to the underground with your loadout randomized.

The achievement pops shortly after getting back to base.
Defeat Hecate with no Arcana cards enabled.

Complete Odysseus side-quest.
To get it you must have
- 10+ hearts with him
- Achieved the ending

After that he'll give you the prophecy "Nobody but Nobody" which will ask you to bring his Keepsake to a bunch of bosses and npcs. After that's done, he'll leave and then come back and give you the achievement.

achievements.description: Fulfill the Prophecy 'Haunted by the Past'
achievements.hint:
The first time Dora accepts Ambrosia as a gift (10 hearts), she'll give you the prophecy "Haunted by the Past" which asks you to speak to Prometheus and then Dora around 4 times. Do note you can still get this if Prometheus is affected by the Vow of Rivals, although the new introductory dialogue will take priority over the quest.

You'll get the achievement after the last time you are required to speak to Dora.

You can only complete this after seeing the ending but you can start it before that.
1st incantation is unlocked by gifting 2 nectar to Hypnos, harvest 1 Poppy then talking to Hypnos.
2nd incantation is unlocked by gifting 1 Dream Vapor to Hypnos and talking to Medea in the surface.
3rd and last incantation is unlocked after giving a total of 2 Dream Vapors to Hypnos and talking to Medea in the surface again.
The unknown material required is obtained after the ending. Go see the chained NPC in Tartarus to receive the material.

You'll get the achievement after doing the last incantation and gifting the item to Hypnos as many times as the game lets you.

Gift 3 Nectar to Arachne and Hecate aswell as 4 to Athena.
Speak to Arachne and Hecate until Hecate tells you information about Arachne's curse and tells you to invite Arachne to the base. 

Speak to Athena

Keep talking and gifting stuff to Narcissus in Oceanus and Echo in Fields of Mourning until you get the incantation "Purification of Crystal Clarity". Do the incantation then keep talking to them both and you'll get the achievement.

achievements.description: Fulfill the Prophecy 'Denizens of the Depths'
achievements.hint:
To fulfill the Prophecy "Denizens of the Depths" you have to fish a total 20 fish. You can do this before or after receiving the prophecy.
You won't get the achievement until you get the Prophecy which might take more time to trigger than to actually catch the fish. 
To get the Prophecy, you have to advance Poseidon's bond/relationship until after it gets locked and then wait for all the story dialogues to ran out.

You can get a higher chance of getting fishing spots by bringing the animal familiar Toula with you.
For more info on Animal Familiars, check the guide in the guides section.

In the "Oath of the Unseen", there are multiple vows you can take. One of them is an unlockable called "Vow of Rivals" which strenghtens/changes the bosses. Rank 1 will affect the first bosses (Hecate and Polyphemus), Rank 2 will affect the second bosses (Scylla and Eris) so on and so forth. To unlock the Vow of Rivals and subsequent ranks, you need to defeat the bosses that will be affected 3+ times, both surface and underworld. After you see them all in their buffed versions, the achievement will pop.

achievements.description: Fulfill the Prophecy 'Sword of the Night'
achievements.hint:
Defeat Typhon using every Infernal Arm. Doesn't matter which aspect, as it counts only the weapon.
If you want to track it without using the prophecy ingame, there's a checklist in the checklists section.

achievements.description: Fulfill the Prophecy 'Arcana of the Ages'
achievements.hint:
To fulfill the prophecy "Arcana of the Ages", you need to defeat Chronos while using each Arcana card (either the same run or multiple).

You can finish a run with 24 out of 25 cards. To do this you need
- All Arcana cards unlocked
- The [XXV] Judgement Arcana unlocked and max upgrades (total cost counting the unlock: 50 Ash, 1 Feather, 30 Moon Dust, 20 Fate Fabric)
- Circe's "Crystal Figurine" Keepsake maxed
- At least 5 grasp
Once you meet all of the requirements, select all of the cards of the last column; [X] Night and [XV] The Lovers. The rest inside that column should turn on automatically. Select 1 more card (any card you like), equip Circe's Keepsake "Crystal Figurine" and then head into an underworld run. For every boss you kill, you'll activate 5 arcana cards and after the first boss, Circe's Keepsake should of have turned on. You can swap the Keepsake for something else once the effect activates, it won't take your arcana away.
By the time you defeat Chronos, you should have 24/25 or 25/25 cards. If you're missing one card, just do another run with that one card selected and whatever else you want.

If for any reason you don't want to do this strategy, there's a checklist of arcana under the Checklists section, aswell as a prophecy ingame telling you which ones you used or are missing.

Defeat a final boss (Chronos or Typhon) with every aspect, including hidden.
For a guide on how to unlock the hidden aspects and a checklist, check the checklists section.

This achievement was hell to me because it seems to require you to find a chaos gate in the surface and enter it once. The surface only has 2 spawns for chaos gates which is the very beginning of the run (as in the starting room) and the very beginning of mount olympus. I did not know this until after three hours of farming seeds.

Besides what I mentioned on the paragraph above, the requirements to get the prophecy is to enter a chaos gate with the chaos embryo keepsake on you. Chaos will comment on it multiple times before giving you the prophecy. 
You can complete the prophecy before you even get it so if you do a full run with it equipped before or after receiving the prophecy, it will still count but you will only get the achievement after obtaining said prophecy.

If you're in the underground, look for Charon Wells having the item "Spark of Ixion" since it guarantees a spawn.
If you got unlucky and didnt get the surface, I recommend waiting to do this after the epilogue since you unlock an incantation that allows you to reset a seed so you won't have to stay still to die and retry but of course, you can always do this before the incantation if you want. 

In short; Start the run with Chaos's Keepsake "Transcendent Embryo" equipped and don't take it off until after you defeat the final boss and are back at the base.

Nemesis can only appear in the first three areas of the Underworld route. Nemesis has a bunch of different kinds of events, you're looking for the one where you two fight enemies together.
Not sure if this was a coincidence or not, but she seems to be behind bone/ash/gold doors and the fighting event seem to have more chances to happen if you have at least 100 gold, since it is what you gotta pay if you lose.

achievements.description: Alter the appearance of each Animal Familiar
achievements.hint:
Given by Circe at the end of the Surface's second zone. 
To unlock her incantation you need to:
- Have all Animal Familiars unlocked
- Spend 20 or more treats on Familiars
- Have a familiar fully upgraded
- Have 30 Grasp.

achievements.description: Slay a Sister of the Dead while afflicted with Twilight Curse
achievements.hint:
In the first area of the Underworld; Erebus, you'll find Hecate as a boss. Sometimes she will have an attack that can turn you into a sheep and you can only dodge and attack (more of a tickle tbh) and move very slowly. Hit one of the trees, aiming towards a Sister of the Dead (the adds) and kill one or more for this achievement to pop.
NOTE: Be careful if you're bringing Frinos as your companion, as they can eat the projectile for you.

achievements.description: Use Night Bloom to raise a Siren
achievements.hint: Selene, the Goddess of the Moon, offers you a hex called "Night Bloom" which resurrects a fallen enemy *of that encounter* and turns them into an ally. When fighting the Sirens in the second area of the Underworld; Oceanus. As soon as you kill one of them, use the hex to resurrect her and get the achievement.

achievements.description: Reach the final confrontation in an Arachne outfit
achievements.hint:
Arachne can be found in Erebus, the first zone of the Underworld, behind a "npc encounter" door. Get one of her outfits and reach Chronos with some armor left. You don't have to beat Chronos, just reach him.
You can use her keepsake to add durability to the outfit aswell as some of Hephaestus's boons if you desire.

achievements.description: Earn the first Gift of the Veil
achievements.hint:
To unlock being able to earn the Gifts of Veil one must
- Obtain the Oath of the Unseen and inspect it
- Complete the Underworld route 5 times or more
- Complete the Surface route 1 time or more.

The first gift is earned after beating [Underworld Fear 8] and [Surface Fear 6].
Note: You can attempt this before Skelly shows you the covered gifts, although the gifts will be uncovered one by one so once you meet the requirements you'll have to do another run (outcome and fear won't matter since those runs are just to free the queued dialogue/events)

achievements.description: Earn the second Gift of the Veil
achievements.hint:
To unlock being able to earn the Gifts of Veil one must
- Obtain the Oath of the Unseen and inspect it
- Complete the Underworld route 5 times or more
- Complete the Surface route 1 time or more.

The second gift is earned after beating [Underworld Fear 16]  and [Surface Fear 12].
*There is a third gift with no achievement at [Underworld Fear 32] and [Surface Fear 24].
Note: You can attempt this before Skelly shows you the covered gifts, although the gifts will be uncovered one by one so once you meet the requirements you'll have to do another run (outcome and fear won't matter since those runs are just to free the queued dialogue/events)

achievements.description: Prevail in the Contest of Champions
achievements.hint: After reaching the True Ending (credits), touch the Infernal Contract in Charon's shop to start a boss encounter. After beating the boss you'll get the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the lifelong task of the Princess of the Underworld
achievements.hint:
To start the ending sequence, you need to complete the Incantation "Disintegration of Monstrosity" and "Dissolution of time"
Do know that once you do one or the other, you start the ending sequence and have to do what the game tells you to, can't do side stuff until after the credits.

achievements.description: Reach the epilogue of the story
achievements.hint:
After getting the credits, you'll get a prophecy asking you to meet the three fates. To do this, you must complete the riddles.
These riddles and their answers are:
- Seek to know he who is our emissary: Max Moros relationship
- Seek to know they who created the world: Speak with Chaos
- Seek to know he who cast us out: Speak with Chronos
- Seek to know she who trained you: Max Hecate's relationship
- Seek to know he who rebels against the gods: Keep fighting Prometheus
- Seek to know he who labors for the gods: Keep talking and gifting nectar to Heracles.

After you got them all, equip Moros's Keepsake, Engraved Pin, and continue to Oceanus. Die and resurrect with the charm 3 different rooms in a row and after the third time allow you to die on purpose and you'll get the achievement.

checklists.title: Prophecy: Bearing Dark Gifts & The Unseen Sentinel

items.name: Aspect of Anubis
items.desc:
To unlock the hidden aspect you have to:
- Unlock all other aspects of this weapon
- Have the aspect of Circe or Momus at max level
- Talk to Circe to get the waking phrase
- Head back to the Silver Pool in the hub

items.name: Aspect of the Morrigan
items.desc:
To unlock the hidden aspect you have to:
- Unlock all other aspects of this weapon
- Have the aspect of Artemis or Pan at max level
- Talk to Artemis to get the waking phrase
- Head back to the Silver Pool in the hub

items.name: Aspect of Supay
items.desc:
To unlock the hidden aspect you have to:
- Unlock all other aspects of this weapon and do a run with each of them
- Have the aspect of Moros or Eos at max level
- Talk to Moros to get the waking phrase
- Head back to the Silver Pool in the hub

items.name: Aspect of Nergal
items.desc:
To unlock the hidden aspect you have to:
- Unlock all other aspects of this weapon
- Have the aspect of Charon or Thanatos at max level
- Talk to Charon to get the waking phrase
- Head back to the Silver Pool in the hub

items.name: Aspect of Hel
items.desc:
To unlock the hidden aspect you have to:
- Unlock all other aspects of this weapon
- Have the aspect of Medea or Persephone at max level
- Talk to Medea to get the waking phrase
- Head back to the Silver Pool in the hub

items.name: Aspect of Shiva
items.desc:
To unlock the hidden aspect you have to:
- Unlock all other aspects of this weapon
- Have the aspect of Selene or Nyx at max level
- Talk to Selene to get the waking phrase
- Head back to the Silver Pool in the hub

items.name: Faith of Familiar Spirits
items.desc:
(Prerequisite to get Animal Familiars)
Unlocked by: 
- Defeating Hecate 7 times or more
- Gathering 2 times with the Crescent Pick
- Gathering 8 times with the Tablet of Peace
- Gathering 1 time with the Silver Spade

items.name: Frinos, the Toad
items.desc:
Frinos is located at the "spawn", after finishing a run.
Just give em some treats and they'll join you.

items.name: Toula, the Cat
items.desc:
Requirements:
- Succesfully fished 1 fish or more in any run
- Able to get to the second zone of the Surface Route

At the start of the second zone, Rift of Thessaly, you'll find Toula the cat at the north west. Interact with Toula in two runs to unlock them.

items.name: Raki, the Raven
items.desc: Visit the Fountain Room in the first zone of the Underworld, Erebus, more than once. You'll find Raki inside that room.

items.name: Hecuba, the Hound
items.desc:
Requirements:
- Be on night 12+
- Nemesis can't be in Echo's room
- Spend at least 2 treats in total recruiting animals
- Use Frinos's ability on a Lost Soul at least once

After those requirements are met, interact with Hecuba in two different runs and they will join you. 
You can find Hecuba in the Fields of Morning, where Echo is.

items.name: Gale, the Polecat
items.desc:
Requirements:
- Be on night 12+
- Spend at least 3 treats in total recruiting animals
- Use Frinos's ability on a Lost Soul at least once

After those requirements are met, interact with Gale in two different runs and they will join you.
You can find Gale in Mount Olympus's Charon Shop, before Prometheus.
